newsitem.title: USA: Metzler closes consulting firm purchase.
newsitem.headline: Metzler closes consulting firm purchase.

text.p: Metzler Group Inc said Monday it had acquired privately owned Reed Consulting Group, a management and financial services consulting firm serving energy industry clients in domestic and international markets.
The transaction will be accounted for as a pooling of interests. Reed had 1996 revenues of $5 million.
Excluding related merger costs, Metzler said it expects a positive contribution to per share earnings in 1997 and thereafter.
Metzler provides consulting services to electric and gas utilities and other energy-related businesses.
Following the transaction, Reed will operate as an independent subsidiary of Metzler.
John Reed, president and founder of Reed Consulting, will remain as president of the Reed operating subsidiary.
